findings.title: Preserve or migrate the existing findMany API
findings.body: This replaces the public `findMany(findManyArgs)` method with `getBaseConditions()`, but the PR contains no migration of production consumers. These APIs are not interchangeable: `findMany` executed a query, honored selection and other query arguments, and applied authorization and filters, whereas `getBaseConditions` only returns a SQL fragment. Existing callers of `service.findMany(...)` will now fail type checking (or throw at runtime). Update all consumers to execute appropriately authorized raw queries in the same change, or retain a compatible query method until they are migrated.
